---
title: "Technology Report"
report-class: process
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    keep_tex: false
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
    css: null
  word_document: default
params:
  name:               "Technology"
  desc:               ""
  cap2act:            !r NA_real_
  units_cap:          ""
  units_act:          ""
  units_costs:        ""
  olife:              !r NA_integer_
  stock:              !r NA_real_
  start:              !r NA_integer_
  end:                !r NA_integer_
  vintage_df:         NULL
  cap_df:             NULL
  input_df:           NULL
  output_df:          NULL
  ceff_df:            NULL
  invcost_df:         NULL
  fixom_df:           NULL
  varom_df:           NULL
  reservoir_df:       NULL
  seff_df:            NULL
  duration_df:        NULL
  storage_cost_df:    NULL
  image_file:         NULL
  draw_file:          NULL
  levcost_plot:       NULL
  frontier_plot:      NULL
  share_frontier_plot: NULL
  levcost_npv:        NULL
  levcost_variants_plot: NULL
  levcost_by_vintage_df: NULL
  levcost_instance_label: NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{geometry}
  - \geometry{a4paper, top=15mm, bottom=15mm, left=15mm, right=15mm}
  - \usepackage{graphicx}
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage{xcolor}
  - \pagenumbering{gobble}
  - \definecolor{ert_blue}{RGB}{31, 73, 125}
  - \definecolor{ert_gray}{RGB}{128, 128, 128}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Shared helpers live in the package (see ?energyRt::report_helpers).
# Local aliases keep the template body unchanged; report_setup() sets the
# chunk defaults and the per-output kable NA placeholder, and returns the
# detected output ("html" / "word" / "latex").
fmt      <- energyRt::report_setup()
is_html  <- fmt == "html"
is_word  <- fmt == "word"
is_latex <- fmt == "latex"

# ── one sizing system (fractions of the text width, everywhere) ───────────────
.LAYOUT   <- energyRt::report_layout()
.HDR_IMG  <- .LAYOUT$hdr_img   # header image column
.SIDE     <- .LAYOUT$side      # schematic column in the two-column body
.MAIN     <- .LAYOUT$main      # table column in the two-column body
.LC_MAIN  <- .LAYOUT$lc_main   # levcost components plot
.LC_SIDE  <- .LAYOUT$lc_side   # frontier plot next to it
.PANEL    <- .LAYOUT$panel     # one share-mix panel
.DPI      <- .LAYOUT$dpi       # every rasterised ggplot

# Safe HTML / TeX escaping + fixed-notation value formatting
html_esc <- function(x) energyRt::report_esc(x, output = "html")
tex_esc  <- function(x) energyRt::report_esc(x, output = "latex")
esc      <- function(x) energyRt::report_esc(x, output = fmt)
fmt_val  <- energyRt::report_fmt_val

# ── shared emitters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Image at a fraction of the line width; the ONLY way images enter the page.
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)

# Rasterise a ggplot at .DPI and return the png path (uniform pipeline for
# all three formats; avoids knitr fig options, which docx partly rejects)
plot_png <- function(p, w_in, h_in)
  energyRt::report_plot_png(p, w_in, h_in, dpi = .DPI)

# Section divider + bold title (+ gray note); Word gets a markdown heading
sec <- function(title, note = NULL)
  energyRt::report_sec(title, note, output = fmt)

# One table pipeline: prune empty columns, round numerics, kable per format.
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt)
```

```{r html_css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r header, results='asis'}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  PAGE HEADER: name + description (left), optional image (right)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
has_img <- !is.null(params$image_file) && nzchar(params$image_file) &&
           file.exists(params$image_file)

if (is_html) {
  cat("<div class='ert-two-col'>\n<div style='flex:1;min-width:0'>\n")
  cat("<h1 style='margin:0 0 4px'>", html_esc(params$name), "</h1>\n", sep = "")
  if (nzchar(params$desc))
    cat("<p class='ert-gray' style='margin:2px 0 8px 0'>",
        html_esc(params$desc), "</p>\n", sep = "")
  cat("</div>\n")
  if (has_img) {
    cat("<div style='flex:0 0 ", round(.HDR_IMG * 100), "%;min-width:0'>\n",
        sep = "")
    emit_img(params$image_file, 1)
    cat("</div>\n")
  }
  cat("</div>\n<hr class='ert-rule' />\n")
} else if (is_word) {
  cat("# ", params$name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nzchar(params$desc)) cat("*", params$desc, "*\n\n", sep = "")
  if (has_img) emit_img(params$image_file, .HDR_IMG + 0.1)
} else {
  txt_w <- if (has_img) 1 - .HDR_IMG - 0.03 else 1
  cat("\\begin{minipage}[t]{", txt_w, "\\textwidth}\n", sep = "")
  cat("{\\Large\\bfseries\\color{ert_blue} ", tex_esc(params$name), "}\\par\n",
      sep = "")
  if (nzchar(params$desc))
    cat("{\\small\\color{ert_gray} ", tex_esc(params$desc), "}\\par\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\end{minipage}")
  if (has_img) {
    cat("\\hfill\n\\begin{minipage}[t]{", .HDR_IMG, "\\textwidth}\n", sep = "")
    cat("\\vspace{0pt}\\raggedleft\n")
    emit_img(params$image_file, 1)
    cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
  }
  cat("\n\\vspace{4pt}\n")
  cat("\\textcolor{ert_blue}{\\rule{\\textwidth}{1.5pt}}\\par\\vspace{4pt}\n")
}
```

```{r main_body, results='asis'}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  MAIN BODY: tables (left column) | draw() schematic (right column)
#  Word: linear flow. Long tables (capacity, costs) go BELOW the two-column
#  block full-width, so they can break across pages.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
has_draw <- !is.null(params$draw_file) && file.exists(params$draw_file)

# combined Inputs / Outputs
io_df <- NULL
add_io <- function(df, dir) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  tmp <- df
  tmp$dir <- dir
  tmp[, intersect(c("dir", "comm", "unit", "group"), names(tmp)), drop = FALSE]
}
io_parts <- Filter(Negate(is.null),
                   list(add_io(params$input_df, "Input"),
                        add_io(params$output_df, "Output"),
                        add_io(params$reservoir_df, "Storage")))
if (length(io_parts) > 0) {
  all_cols <- unique(unlist(lapply(io_parts, names)))
  io_parts <- lapply(io_parts, function(d) {
    for (cc in setdiff(all_cols, names(d))) d[[cc]] <- NA
    d[, all_cols, drop = FALSE]
  })
  io_df <- do.call(rbind, io_parts)
}

key_params_table <- function() {
  kp <- list()
  if (!is.na(params$cap2act)) kp[["cap2act"]] <- fmt_val(params$cap2act)
  if (!is.na(params$olife))   kp[["olife"]]   <- paste(params$olife, "yr")
  if (!is.na(params$start))   kp[["start"]]   <- as.character(params$start)
  if (!is.na(params$end))     kp[["end"]]     <- as.character(params$end)
  if (!is.na(params$stock))   kp[["stock"]]   <-
    paste(fmt_val(params$stock), params$units_cap)
  if (nzchar(params$units_cap))   kp[["cap unit"]]  <- params$units_cap
  if (nzchar(params$units_act))   kp[["act unit"]]  <- params$units_act
  if (nzchar(params$units_costs)) kp[["cost unit"]] <- params$units_costs
  if (length(kp) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (is_html) {
    cat("<p><strong>Key Parameters</strong></p>\n")
    cat("<table class='ert-kp-table'><tbody>\n")
    for (k in names(kp))
      cat("  <tr><td>", html_esc(k), "</td><td><strong>",
          html_esc(as.character(kp[[k]])), "</strong></td></tr>\n", sep = "")
    cat("</tbody></table>\n")
  } else if (is_word) {
    cat("**Key Parameters**\n\n")
    tbl(data.frame(parameter = names(kp),
                   value = unlist(kp, use.names = FALSE)))
  } else {
    cat("{\\small\\bfseries Key Parameters}\\par\\vspace{1pt}\n")
    cat("\\begin{tabular}{@{}ll@{}}\n")
    for (k in names(kp))
      cat("  \\small\\texttt{", tex_esc(k), "} & {\\bfseries\\small ",
          tex_esc(as.character(kp[[k]])), "} \\\\\n", sep = "")
    cat("\\end{tabular}\\par\\vspace{4pt}\n")
  }
}

left_tables <- function() {
  key_params_table()
  tbl(params$vintage_df, caption = "Vintages")
  tbl(io_df,             caption = "Inputs / Outputs")
  tbl(params$ceff_df,    caption = "Efficiency (ceff)")
  tbl(params$seff_df,    caption = "Efficiency (seff)")
  tbl(params$duration_df, caption = "Duration (energy/power ratio, h)")
}

if (is_html) {
  cat("<div class='ert-two-col'>\n<div class='ert-col-main'>\n")
  left_tables()
  cat("</div>\n")
  if (has_draw) {
    cat("<div class='ert-col-side'>\n<p><strong>Schematic</strong></p>\n")
    emit_img(params$draw_file, 1)
    cat("</div>\n")
  }
  cat("</div>\n")
} else if (is_word) {
  left_tables()
  if (has_draw) {
    cat("\n## Schematic\n\n")
    emit_img(params$draw_file, 0.8)
  }
} else {
  left_w <- if (has_draw) .MAIN else 1
  cat("\\begin{minipage}[t]{", left_w, "\\textwidth}\n\\vspace{0pt}\n", sep = "")
  left_tables()
  cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
  if (has_draw) {
    cat("\\hfill\n\\begin{minipage}[t]{", .SIDE, "\\textwidth}\n", sep = "")
    cat("\\vspace{0pt}\n{\\small\\bfseries Schematic}\\par\\vspace{2pt}\n")
    emit_img(params$draw_file, 1)
    cat("\\end{minipage}\n\\par\n")
  }
}

# capacity bounds flow full-width below (may be long)
if (!is.null(params$cap_df) && nrow(params$cap_df) > 0) {
  sec("Capacity bounds", params$units_cap)
  tbl(params$cap_df)
}
```

```{r costs_section, results='asis'}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  COSTS -- one tidy table (per vintage / region / year when keyed);
#  a year chart replaces the table when costs vary over years
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cost_labels <- c(invcost = "Investment cost", fixom = "Fixed O&M",
                 varom = "Variable O&M")
cost_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null),
                    list(invcost = params$invcost_df,
                         fixom   = params$fixom_df,
                         varom   = params$varom_df))

tidy_costs <- NULL
if (length(cost_list) > 0) {
  tidy_costs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(cost_list), function(ct) {
    df <- cost_list[[ct]]
    cost_col <- if (ct %in% names(df)) ct else {
      cands <- setdiff(names(df), c("vintage", "cluster", "region", "year"))
      if (length(cands) > 0) cands[1] else return(NULL)
    }
    out <- data.frame(cost = rep(unname(cost_labels[ct]), nrow(df)),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for (cc in c("vintage", "cluster", "region", "year"))
      out[[cc]] <- if (cc %in% names(df)) df[[cc]] else rep(NA, nrow(df))
    out$value <- df[[cost_col]]
    out
  }))
  tidy_costs <- tidy_costs[!is.na(tidy_costs$value), , drop = FALSE]
}

# storage costs arrive pre-tidied (part folded into the cost label:
# "Investment cost (stg)" etc.) with the same columns as tidy_costs
if (!is.null(params$storage_cost_df) && nrow(params$storage_cost_df) > 0) {
  sc <- params$storage_cost_df
  sc <- sc[!is.na(sc$value), , drop = FALSE]
  tidy_costs <- if (is.null(tidy_costs)) sc else rbind(tidy_costs, sc)
}

if (!is.null(tidy_costs) && nrow(tidy_costs) > 0) {
  multi_year <- length(unique(tidy_costs$year[!is.na(tidy_costs$year)])) > 1

  sec("Costs", if (nzchar(params$units_costs))
    paste0("[", params$units_costs, "]") else NULL)

  if (!multi_year) {
    show <- tidy_costs[, c("cost", "vintage", "cluster", "region", "value"),
                       drop = FALSE]
    tbl(show)
  } else {
    # Lines only where they mean something: a line through one point per
    # vintage would fake a cross-vintage time series. Each vintage's segment
    # spans the years where the cost APPLIES -- invcost over the vintage's
    # investment window (start..end), O&M over its potential lifespan
    # (start .. end + olife - 1) -- with back.inter.forth interpolation
    # (linear inside, constant beyond), matching the model.
    vd  <- params$vintage_df
    fin <- function(x) x[is.finite(x)]
    x_cap <- suppressWarnings(max(fin(c(
      tidy_costs$year,
      if (!is.null(vd)) c(as.numeric(vd$start), as.numeric(vd$end))))))
    segs <- list()
    for (ct in unique(tidy_costs$cost)) {
      sub_ct <- tidy_costs[tidy_costs$cost == ct, , drop = FALSE]
      for (v in unique(sub_ct$vintage)) {
        r <- if (is.na(v)) sub_ct[is.na(sub_ct$vintage), , drop = FALSE] else
          sub_ct[!is.na(sub_ct$vintage) & sub_ct$vintage == v, , drop = FALSE]
        if (nrow(r) == 0) next
        vr <- if (!is.null(vd) && !is.na(v) && "vintage" %in% names(vd))
          vd[!is.na(vd$vintage) & vd$vintage == v, , drop = FALSE] else NULL
        vs <- function(col) {
          if (!is.null(vr) && nrow(vr) > 0 && col %in% names(vr) &&
              is.finite(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vr[[col]][1]))))
            as.numeric(vr[[col]][1]) else NA_real_
        }
        s0 <- vs("start")
        if (!is.finite(s0)) s0 <- suppressWarnings(min(fin(r$year)))
        if (!is.finite(s0)) s0 <- suppressWarnings(min(fin(tidy_costs$year)))
        e0 <- vs("end")
        if (!is.finite(e0)) e0 <- x_cap
        ol <- vs("olife")
        xe <- if (ct == "Investment cost") e0 else
          if (is.finite(ol)) e0 + ol - 1 else e0
        if (!is.finite(xe) || xe < s0) xe <- max(s0, e0, na.rm = TRUE)
        xs <- seq(s0, xe)
        ry <- fin(unique(r$year))
        yy <- if (length(ry) < 2) rep(r$value[1], length(xs)) else
          stats::approx(r$year, r$value, xout = xs, rule = 2)$y
        segs[[length(segs) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
          cost = ct, vintage = if (is.na(v)) "all" else as.character(v),
          year = xs, value = yy, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }
    }
    sd <- do.call(rbind, segs)
    pts <- tidy_costs[!is.na(tidy_costs$year), , drop = FALSE]
    pts$vintage <- ifelse(is.na(pts$vintage), "all", as.character(pts$vintage))
    y_lab <- if (nzchar(params$units_costs)) params$units_costs else "Cost"
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(sd, ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = value,
                                          colour = vintage, group = vintage)) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(data = pts, size = 1.5) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = y_lab, colour = "vintage") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
      ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                     panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                     plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2)) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ cost, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1)
    emit_img(plot_png(p, 6.5, 2.4), 1)
  }
}
```

```{r share_frontier_section, results='asis'}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  SHARE MIX CONSTRAINTS -- grid of geometric share panels
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sfr_list <- params$share_frontier_plot
if (!is.null(sfr_list) && length(sfr_list) > 0) {
  sec("Share Mix Constraints")
  panel_in <- .PANEL * 6.5           # fraction of a 6.5 in text width
  if (is_html) cat("<div style='display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;align-items:flex-start'>\n")
  for (i in seq_along(sfr_list)) {
    pf <- plot_png(sfr_list[[i]], panel_in, panel_in)
    if (is_latex) {
      cat("\\begin{minipage}[t]{", .PANEL, "\\textwidth}\n\\vspace{0pt}\n",
          sep = "")
      emit_img(pf, 1)
      cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
    } else {
      emit_img(pf, if (is_word) .PANEL + 0.1 else .PANEL)
    }
  }
  if (is_html) cat("</div>\n")
}
```

```{r levcost_section, results='asis'}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  LEVELIZED COST -- components / frontier side by side. Rendered ONLY for a
#  technology WITHOUT vintages: with vintages the by-vintage section already
#  shows every instance, and a second single-instance figure just repeats one
#  of its bars.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
has_lc <- !is.null(params$levcost_plot)
has_fr <- !is.null(params$frontier_plot)
has_vint <- !is.null(params$levcost_variants_plot) ||
  (!is.null(params$levcost_by_vintage_df) &&
     nrow(params$levcost_by_vintage_df) > 0)

# Cost per unit of output. When the cost unit ALREADY carries a denominator
# (a user-supplied cost_unit like "EUR/MWh"), pass it through -- appending
# the activity unit again produced "EUR/MWh/GWh".
lcoe_unit <- if (grepl("/", params$units_costs, fixed = TRUE) ||
                 !nzchar(params$units_act) || !nzchar(params$units_costs)) {
  params$units_costs
} else {
  paste0(params$units_costs, "/", params$units_act)
}

# "Levelized cost per unit of <output commodity>" -- the output is not
# necessarily energy, so no hardwired "LCOE"
out_comm_lbl <- if (!is.null(params$output_df) && "comm" %in% names(params$output_df))
  paste(unique(params$output_df$comm), collapse = " + ") else ""
lc_title <- if (nzchar(out_comm_lbl))
  paste0("Levelized Cost per unit of ", out_comm_lbl) else "Levelized Cost"

if (!has_vint && (has_lc || has_fr)) {
  npv_note <- NULL
  if (!is.null(params$levcost_npv) && is.finite(params$levcost_npv)) {
    npv_note <- paste0("NPV: ", fmt_val(params$levcost_npv),
                       if (nzchar(lcoe_unit)) paste0(" ", lcoe_unit) else "")
  }
  sec(lc_title, npv_note)

  if (has_lc && has_fr) {
    f_main <- plot_png(params$levcost_plot,  .LC_MAIN * 6.5, 3.2)
    f_side <- plot_png(params$frontier_plot, .LC_SIDE * 6.5, 3.2)
    if (is_html) {
      cat("<div class='ert-two-col'>\n<div style='flex:0 0 ",
          round(.LC_MAIN * 100), "%;min-width:0'>\n", sep = "")
      emit_img(f_main, 1)
      cat("</div>\n<div style='flex:0 0 ", round(.LC_SIDE * 100),
          "%;min-width:0'>\n", sep = "")
      emit_img(f_side, 1)
      cat("</div>\n</div>\n")
    } else if (is_word) {
      emit_img(f_main, 0.9)
      emit_img(f_side, 0.7)
    } else {
      cat("\\begin{minipage}[t]{", .LC_MAIN, "\\textwidth}\n\\vspace{0pt}\n",
          sep = "")
      emit_img(f_main, 1)
      cat("\\end{minipage}\\hfill\n")
      cat("\\begin{minipage}[t]{", .LC_SIDE, "\\textwidth}\n\\vspace{0pt}\n",
          sep = "")
      emit_img(f_side, 1)
      cat("\\end{minipage}\n\\par\n")
    }
  } else {
    # a lone plot gets more room -- narrow rasters crop bottom legends
    only <- if (has_lc) params$levcost_plot else params$frontier_plot
    emit_img(plot_png(only, 0.72 * 6.5, 3.0), 0.72)
  }
}
```

```{r levcost_by_vintage, results='asis'}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  LEVELIZED COST BY VINTAGE -- comparison chart + per-vintage NPV table.
#  For a vintaged technology this is THE levelized-cost section (the
#  single-instance figure above is suppressed); the instance frontier plot,
#  when available, rides along here.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
lv_df <- params$levcost_by_vintage_df
if (has_vint) {
  sec(paste0(lc_title, ", by vintage"),
      if (nzchar(lcoe_unit)) paste0("[", lcoe_unit, "]") else NULL)

  if (!is.null(params$levcost_variants_plot)) {
    n_var <- if (!is.null(lv_df)) nrow(lv_df) else 4L
    # wide enough that the bottom component legend never crops
    w_in <- min(6.5, max(4.8, 2.2 + 1.0 * n_var))
    emit_img(plot_png(params$levcost_variants_plot, w_in, 2.8),
             w_in / 6.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(lv_df) && nrow(lv_df) > 0) {
    show <- lv_df
    if ("levcost_npv" %in% names(show)) {
      names(show)[names(show) == "levcost_npv"] <-
        if (nzchar(lcoe_unit)) paste0("levcost (NPV), ", lcoe_unit) else
          "levcost (NPV)"
    }
    show <- show[, setdiff(names(show), "tech"), drop = FALSE]
    tbl(show)
  }

  if (has_fr) {
    if (!is.null(params$levcost_instance_label) &&
        nzchar(params$levcost_instance_label)) {
      note <- paste0("Production frontier (instance: ",
                     params$levcost_instance_label, ")")
      if (is_html) cat("<p class='ert-gray'><small>", html_esc(note),
                       "</small></p>\n", sep = "")
      else if (is_word) cat("*", note, "*\n\n", sep = "")
      else cat("{\\small\\color{ert_gray} ", tex_esc(note),
               "}\\par\\vspace{2pt}\n", sep = "")
    }
    emit_img(plot_png(params$frontier_plot, .LC_SIDE * 6.5, 3.0), .LC_SIDE)
  }
}
```
